results.content:
## Other apps compete for your attention. Space builds your memory.

### vs. Note-taking apps

Notion, Obsidian, Roam capture information. Space makes you remember it. Capture without retrieval is storage, not learning.

 No retrieval practice built in
 No intelligent scheduling
 No forgetting curve awareness

### vs. Legacy tools

Anki pioneered spaced repetition. Space modernizes it: FSRS-6 over SM-2, native AI, real-time sync across 5 platforms, and a UI that belongs on a modern phone. [...] Retention, not engagement.

# A modern Anki alternative for serious learners.

Same proven spaced repetition. Native apps that don't fight you. AI turns your PDFs, articles, and photos into cards in seconds.

Get Space free   See how it works

Free on iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux.

4.6 · Loved by 150,000+ learners

Space home: 5-day learning streak, daily goal 10 of 30 cards, deck list below.

## The bottleneck isn't input. It's retention. [...] > "Finally a spaced repetition app that works on all my devices and looks great doing it."
>
> — Mac App Store Review

## Frequently asked questions

Is this just a flashcard app? 

No. Space is a knowledge retention system. Active recall is the interface; the intelligence sits in the FSRS-6 scheduler and the AI pipeline.
